missingReasons.bad_symbol: the symbol is not one the chart data can be read for
missingReasons.breadth_unavailable: no warm live breadth reading and no wire breadth value
missingReasons.no_report_date: no upcoming report date was found for the symbol
missingReasons.no_scan_published: no UCT scanner run had been published
missingReasons.no_screens_swept: none of the member's saved screens had a nightly sweep
missingReasons.rs_cache_cold: the RS rankings cache was cold (the background warmer had not run)
missingReasons.rs_not_ranked: the symbol is not in the RS-ranked universe
missingReasons.source_error: the source could not be read when the context was frozen
missingReasons.wire_unavailable: the morning wire's exposure block was not available

notCaptured.entry_day_unknown: The broker reported this holding without its entry date, so there is no entry day to freeze a market context for.
notCaptured.not_captured: No market context was captured for this entry. It is frozen only on the day of the entry, and a past day is never reconstructed.
